title: Concerted Rollout Checklist for New Model Additions (catalog, benchmarks, docs, announcements)
creator: Aisha Khan
description: This ticket coordinates a cross-functional, stage-gated rollout for adding a new model to the Redwood catalog. It consolidates the checklist items required for: model catalog entry, benchmark publication, docs + migration guides, release notes, and announcement channels. The goal is to minimize customer regressions, provide clear upgrade guidance, and ensure alignment across engineering, design, DX, and GTM teams.
acceptance_criteria: Model entry published in catalog with correct metadata, tags, and compatibility matrix
Benchmark report published with percentile latency, cost/unit, and sample generation quality metrics
Docs updated: quickstart, SDK snippets, migration notes, and FAQ
Release notes drafted and timing approved by legal and security
Announcement assets ready (blog, changelog, in-console banner, social copy) and distribution owners assigned
Telemetry & alerts configured: error rate, latency P95/P99, cost anomalies, and quality regression hooks
Canary rollout plan and fallback model variant defined and smoke-tested
checklist: Pre-launch (two weeks out):
- Confirm DRI list and communication channels (Slack #catalog-launch, weekly standups)
- Create catalog draft entry: name, description, model size, license, tags (decoder/encoder/chat), recommended use-cases
- Verify model artifacts: weight checksum, quantization variants, supported sequence lengths
- Run baseline benchmarks on standard harness (latency, throughput, memory, cost per token) and capture artifacts
- Run quality evals on curated prompt set and record hallucination / safety metrics
- Produce sample SDK code snippets for Python, Node, and REST; validate against hosted and dedicated endpoints
- Security & privacy: confirm data-flow diagram and KMS/HSM handling for Private deployments
- Legal review: license compatibility and export controls validated
Release notes and comms (one week out):
- Draft release notes using release template: what changed, migration steps, known limitations, compat matrix
- Draft blog + in-console banner copy and request review from comms and marketing
- Prepare social copy and asset list (screenshots, benchmark callouts, GIFs showing latency improvements)
- Create internal enablement: sales one-pager, support FAQ, engineering runbook link
Launch day (day 0):
- Publish catalog entry and link benchmark report
- Publish release notes and deploy in-console banner (schedule end-user visibility window)
- Enable telemetry dashboards: model usage, per-route latency, cost per token, error rates
- Start canary traffic: 5% traffic routed to new model with close monitoring
Post-launch (first 7 days):
- Monitor SLOs and quality guardrails; trigger rollback if >= 2 major regressions or error spike > 3x baseline
- Collect early feedback from internal beta customers and Solutions Engineering
- Update docs for any common integration issues observed
- Schedule retrospective and capture learnings and follow-ups
